arStrings.szText: You invoke the Burning Hells too lightly, mortal. Words are not hollow here. Choose yours with more care.
There was once a time your kind bowed to neither angel nor demon. I would not see that change. But speak quickly. The magic wanes.
Warmer and softer than her normal commanding tone. She has a love for humankind. Goes back to normal when saying "But speak quickly..."
Elder one, we seek to restore the Sightless Eye. We have shrouded visions without it. If we cannot see fully, we cannot protect ourselves.
You are trying to command that which was never meant for you. What you call the Sightless Eye will only answer to the one who created it. He put the Eye to rest long ago. As should you.
You have heard Heaven’s council. The veil closes. Be free from this burden.
